THE URBAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY LAW No. 41 OF 1978 ENACTED BY THE NATIONAL
STATE ASSEMBLY
Order under Section 15(1)

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 15(1) of the Urban Development Authority Law No. 41 of 1978enacted by the National State Assembly, I, Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Megapolis and Western Developmentdo by this Order to vest with the Urban Development Authority which effect from today, land situated in Bloemendhalwithin Municipal Council Limits of Colombo described morefully in the Schedule hereto being the land belonging toColombo Municipal Council.
PATALI CHAMPIKA RANAWAKA (MP),Minister of Megapolis & Wesetern Development.Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development,17th and 18th Floors,Suhurupaya,Battaramulla.22nd June 2018.
SCHEDULE

The land containing in extent of 0.1105 Ha.(0A., 1R., 3.66P.) depicted as Lots C, D & E in Clarification TracingNo. CO/DSO/2016/208 dated 20.04.2016 prepared by Surveyor General situated in the village of Bloemendhal in DivisionalSecretary’s Division of Colombo within Municipal Council Limits of Colombo in the District of Colombo, WesternProvince. The said land is bounded as follows :

Extent : 0.0898 Ha.

North by:Lot B in Clarification Tracing No. CO/DSO/2016/208 ;East by:Lot No. 02 in P. P. A. 1548 ;South by:Road between Ciril C. Perera Mawatha and Sirimavo Bandaranayaka Mawatha andLot No. 11 in P. P. Co. 6160 ;West by:Lot D in Clarification Tracing No. CO/DSO/2016/208 and Lot No. 11 in P. P. Co. 6160.
